start.text: Hi! Welcome to HiveNest Whitefield! Fully furnished, gym, café, community nights — everything's on the app! Shall I walk you through pricing?

price.text: Single room, ₹15,000 a month. Three months' deposit, plus a small ₹2,000 onboarding fee. Super transparent!

signed.text: Welcome to the Hive! Your app invite is on its way.

walked.text: No worries! I'll message you the brochure. The offer's valid till Sunday!

look.text: Sure! Grab a cold brew on your way out — oh, it's ₹240. Ha.
